title: Flat Troll Blue Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass, 15 Lb, Allied Brass
description: Modern retractable wall hook for bathroom use with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5 inch pull-out hanging space for towels, robes, and clothing — available in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. This wall-mounted hook retracts back in when not in use for a clean look in modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures. Brass construction; wall mount installation for standard interior walls. Includes mounting hardware and toggle bolts; installation requires drilling a 3/4 inch dia. hole through drywall plus three small holes around the opening. Weight capacity: 15 lb. Customize the look by removing the included knob tip and replacing it with your own cabinet knob. Dimensions: 2 in L x 2 in H x 3.75 in W; projection 1 in; product weight 1 lb. Lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
